import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Size
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
colors = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff', '#99ff99']
ax2.pie(size_sales.values, labels=size_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sales by Payment Method
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_sales = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
payment_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color='coral')
ax3.set_title('Sales by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Sales by Age Group
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_sales.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax4, color='lightgreen')
ax4.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 5. Sales Over Time
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
hourly_sales = df.groupby('time')['total'].sum()
ax5.plot(range(len(hourly_sales)), hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='purple')
ax5.set_title('Sales by Time of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Time')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(hourly_sales)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(hourly_sales.index, rotation=45)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_pie = ['#ffcc99', '#99ccff']
ax6.pie(takeaway_sales.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie)
ax6.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Quantity Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['quantity'].hist(ax=ax7, bins=5, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_title('Quantity Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 8. Average Price by Product
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
avg_price = df.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
avg_price.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax8, color='orange')
ax8.set_title('Average Price by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Product')
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Price ($)')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add main title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
